Break uncooked spaghetti into three pieces: which ones close?

Goal: I can decide if three lengths form a triangle.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Triangle Inequality: the sum of any two sides of a triangle is greater than the third side.

So three lengths a, b, c make a triangle exactly when each is less than the sum of the other two. In practice: the two shorter lengths must add to more than the longest. 3, 4, 6 works (3 + 4 = 7 > 6). 3, 4, 8 does not (3 + 4 = 7 < 8), and 3, 4, 7 collapses to a flat segment.

If two sides are a and b, the third side x satisfies |a − b| < x < a + b.
